titles.title: Leaf Motif – No. 1

description: A large white leaf dominates the center of the canvas. A smaller, bluish white leaf rises from the bottom edge of the composition. Another red, leaflike form extends downward from the top edge of the image. The background of this semiabstract work is red and black and features purple, blue, and orange forms.
title: Leaf Motif, No. 1
